b.clean:
Subject: Treg an appraisal for the silver Accord.

Hi Antonio, thanks for coming by on Saturday. I wanted to put the offer in writing so you have it. We appraised your 2090 Honda Accord at $14,500, which accounts for the mileage, about 62,000, and the small dent on the rear door. If you decide to go ahead with the new crossover we can apply that amount directly to the down payment. The offer is good through the end of the month. You mentioned you were also looking at financing, so I've asked our finance manager to put together a couple of options at different terms. I'll send those over tomorrow afternoon. Let me know if you have any questions at all.
